description: Semantic + keyword search across the full text of Iranian statutes (60,000+ articles: قانون مدنی، مجازات اسلامی، کار، تجارت، آیین دادرسی و…). USE THIS BEFORE ANSWERING ANY QUESTION ABOUT IRANIAN LAW — do not rely on memory; article numbers and wording are frequently misremembered, and amended articles are a common trap. Returns matching articles with their exact article number, law title, a text excerpt, and a source_url to the full article. Cite the article number and link the source_url.

law_filter.description: Optional: restrict to one law, e.g. «قانون مدنی» or «قانون کار».

query.description: The legal question or topic, in Persian or English. Persian gives better recall.
